latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Text to Video Editor Free.

- Instantly converts text prompts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT, up to 200MB) into ready-to-share 1080p MP4 videos with visuals and background music.
- No editing experience required — users simply describe their video and receive a downloadable result.
- Automatic cloud-based rendering with seamless session/token handling for fast, secure video generation.
- Supports quick edits, iterative refinements, and batch file uploads in one session.
- Built-in commands for exporting, viewing credits, uploading files, and checking project status.
